issue.title: Add independently verified qmatch QROM corpus cases
issue.body:
## Defect and scope

The maintained algorithm corpus does not yet exercise the actual `qmatch` source construct with an independently verified positive translation and a semantic counterexample. Tests of multiway control exist, but they do not satisfy the upstream-derived corpus coverage originally tracked by #195. The maintainer requested moving this unfinished work out of #195 into a bug with no target version or milestone. This transfer does not turn the missing evidence into a passed check.

Related: #195 (feature/integration record), #64 (typed source integration), #142 (audit). The distinct general-composition and rectangular-case work-budget defects remain #472 and #517; do not duplicate or relax them here.

## Retained experiment

The [first audit and actual observations](https://github.com/MGYamada/Qleisli/issues/195#issuecomment-6797603729) found no `qmatch` in maintained corpus inputs at `965c1657f368ee1a38f5cb5b6e5bbfd51c4c9210`. The previous QROM corpus test exercised its CNOT/X translation, not a qmatch version.

Reuse the existing approved Apache-2.0 Qualtran source, commit `8db02b8b3fb39d69d2900dcc7b52d9d6a36834c3`, file `qualtran/bloqs/data_loading/qrom.py`. The bounded contract uses two address bits and two target bits:

`|address,target> -> |address, target XOR [1,2,3,0][address]>`

The first tuple leaf has bit weight one. All amplitudes are exactly +1 on the specified transitions, including coherent superpositions and reference correlations. The written arm order is deliberately noncanonical: `3 => keep, 1 => load2, 0 => load1, 2 => load3`.

Two initial source attempts met a parser boundary for direct generic helper calls in basis expressions. A separate repair uses existing `put_bit`/`take_bit` and explicitly consumes the zero-width remainder. With a closed observing entry, project checking succeeded (91 native decisions, 4 requests), while reporting `source_preservation_verified: false`. The wrong-arm case and independent intended-action check have not been run. Check success alone is not an algorithm-semantic result.

First/repair kernel SHA-256 values are `655b76535f24f52e4c78d9530b8a8ddb93cb14519fa21cf2d75565d13874f4fe`, `7d78cceb0f16a6d8e743e342a69244491bd63fc7c54af7a3f98ea72883dae5c0`, and `5d007b6b1fe6b5063462bd6578313af254ffd28a8880a6528860f73f2973b094`. The linked audit records the unchanged-source/binary windows and retained local study `resume-qmatch-seven-20261101/corpus-qmatch-first-20261111`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Preserve the first sources and actual diagnostics; add a maintained qmatch QROM translation under the existing corpus policy, source pin, license and notices.
- [ ] Check its complete four-qubit input/output contract against an independent exact oracle, including arbitrary target inputs, original address order and full relative/scalar phase. Compare to the existing explicit implementation without making either implementation the only oracle.
- [ ] Add a valid but semantically wrong arm-label/action mutation. Require an actual semantic mismatch, not a parser, ownership, unavailable-profile or capacity error.
- [ ] Retain coherent/reference-sensitive probes and exact ordered outputs; distinguish numerical execution observations, native equations and the actual source-preservation proof scope.
- [ ] Register the positive/negative cases in maintained corpus discovery and relevant normal/MSRV/native checks. Keep the production work and quantum-size limits unchanged; do not generate maximum-size cases.
- [ ] Record exact source/IR identities, performed/skipped checks, latest-head CI/review and final evidence links here and in #195/#142. No general QS/PR/RS/EXACT guarantee is inferred from corpus success.

No target release or milestone is assigned. Closing #195 after the explicitly authorized transfer does not close this bug or certify the missing corpus evidence.

audit.body:
## Deferred corpus audit finding — 2026-11-11

Recorded under this issue's existing positive/negative corpus criterion, following the maintainer's instruction to record newly found problems and continue the current PR integration. No duplicate backlog or completion credit.

At `965c1657f368ee1a38f5cb5b6e5bbfd51c4c9210`, maintained `corpus/**/*.qli` inputs contain no `qmatch` use. The earlier QROM corpus experiment exercised the CNOT/X implementation and its reversed-target fault, not a qmatch translation. `tests/static_semantics.rs` and `tests/selected_runtime_execution.rs` separately cover exact multiway action, phase/axes, qif agreement and malformed partitions; this must not be described as an integrated upstream-derived qmatch corpus case.

A bounded candidate reuses the frozen Apache-2.0 Qualtran QROM source `8db02b8b3fb39d69d2900dcc7b52d9d6a36834c3:qualtran/bloqs/data_loading/qrom.py` and the existing four-qubit contract: preserve two address bits and XOR `[1,2,3,0][address]` into an arbitrary two-bit target, first tuple leaf least significant. It uses four named arms implementing target XOR 0/1/2/3, with written order `3 => keep, 1 => load2, 0 => load1, 2 => load3`. No additional upstream source or maximum-size case was used.

The first source attempted direct `prepend_bit[1]` inside a basis expression; the actual diagnostic was `parse: expected }`, followed by `found [` at kernel.qli:8:36. A separate named-classical-helper repair encountered the same grammar boundary at 8:16. Both original sources and outputs were retained. A second repair uses existing `put_bit`/`take_bit` to assemble the two-bit selector and consumes its zero-width remainder with `std::structure::consume_empty`.

With a schema-2 edition-2026 manifest and a closed main initializing four zero bits, calling the kernel and explicitly measuring all returned owners, `qleisli check ... --format=json` succeeded. It reported 91 native decisions, 4 checked requests and `source_preservation_verified: false`. This is a checking observation, **not** validation of the intended QROM action, source preservation or corpus completion. The contemplated swapped-arm negative and independent semantic oracle have not been run; corpus integration is deferred.

Retained local study: `resume-qmatch-seven-20261101/corpus-qmatch-first-20261111` under the ongoing source-resolution evidence directory. It contains three separate source directories, plans with file/binary hashes, actual full stdout/stderr and exit records. Kernel SHA-256 values:

- first: `655b76535f24f52e4c78d9530b8a8ddb93cb14519fa21cf2d75565d13874f4fe`
- repair 1: `7d78cceb0f16a6d8e743e342a69244491bd63fc7c54af7a3f98ea72883dae5c0`
- repair 2: `5d007b6b1fe6b5063462bd6578313af254ffd28a8880a6528860f73f2973b094`

Observed CLI SHA-256: `a9abf495beb95d0c33ae945b7981e3307d57c1148879d77eaf70e348c4ad8d97`; native SHA-256: `abbce360dbb4dcf9425872c93e16456b576623f46bd9daeef25b7bdf841658ae`. Sources and binaries were unchanged across each observation. These hashes identify observed binaries, not compilation attestations.

Follow-up: retain licensing and first observations, integrate a maintained qmatch QROM translation plus a deliberately wrong arm case, and run the independent small-system semantic oracle including coherent/relative-phase probes. This criterion stays open until that evidence exists. Current #516/#518/#519 proof and implementation PR integration proceeds separately.
